title: G-Buffer Layout for Deferred PBR (5 Render Targets)
description: Standard G-Buffer layout: RT0 (RGBA8) = BaseColor.rgb + Metallic.a, RT1 (RGB10A2) = WorldNormal (octahedral encoding) + Roughness, RT2 (RGBA8) = Emissive.rgb + AO.a, Depth (D32_FLOAT) = Scene depth, Velocity (RG16_FLOAT) = Screen-space velocity for TAA/motion blur. Lighting pass reconstructs world position from depth via fullscreen quad. This layout follows UE5's G-Buffer conventions.
whenToUse: When implementing new deferred rendering passes. When adding new material properties (must fit existing RT slots or migrate to bindless). When debugging G-Buffer output via debug view modes.
whenNotToUse: For forward-rendered objects (translucents, special materials). For compute-only passes.
